detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

The SBOM from the day you deployed describes the day you deployed.

Since then, a container may have run unchanged for 2 months while new CVEs landed against its base image, or been patched in place by someone on call. Diffing builds won't surface either.

Runtime drift detection polls the Kubernetes API, lists every running container by digest, and analyzes those images directly, using a read-only service account.

https://anchore.com/blog/sbom-drift-detection/

#SBOM #Kubernetes #DevSecOps
